name: Kamran Mirza
contribution: The second son of Babur, the founder of the Mughal Empire and the first Mughal Emperor.

checks.lead: Kamran Mirza (Persian: کامران میرزا; c. 1509 – 16/18 October 1557) was the second son of Babur, the founder of the Mughal Empire and the first Mughal Emperor. Kamran Mirza was born in Kabul to Babur's wife Gulrukh Begum. He was half-brother to Babur's eldest son Humayun, who would go on and inherit the Mughal throne, but he was full-brother to Babur's third son, Askari. A divan written in Persian and Chagatai is attributed to him.
